items.docs: Verify a business entity by name in a specific jurisdiction. Returns verification results synchronously if available within timeout, or a job ID for async retrieval via GET /v1/verify/status/:jobId. Charges credits based on tier: quick (1 credit), deep (15 credits), deep + force_refresh (25 credits). items.docs: Check the status of an async verification job. Poll this endpoint after POST /v1/verify returns status "pending" with a job_id. Returns the full verification result once the job completes.
